name: dungeon-blitz-r-launcher
description: Dungeon Blitz: R launcher that runs the game in FlashBrowser or Adobe's standalone Flash Player

scripts.test: node tools/test-presence.js && node tools/test-chat-relay.js && node tools/test-game-stats.js && node tools/test-damage-meter.js && node tools/test-linked-lobby.js && node tools/test-launcher-session-recovery.js && node tools/test-social-bridge.js && node tools/test-discord-ipc.js && node tools/test-launcher-status.js && node tools/test-install-location.js && node tools/test-package-files.js && node tools/test-updater.js && node tools/test-windows-support.js && node tools/test-projector.js && node tools/test-flash-browser.js && node tools/test-discord-login-key.js
scripts.predist:win: node tools/fetch-projector.js --platform win32 && node tools/fetch-flash-browser.js --platform win32 --arch x64 && node tools/preflight.js --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.predist:win:ia32: node tools/fetch-projector.js --platform win32 && node tools/fetch-flash-browser.js --platform win32 --arch ia32 && node tools/preflight.js --platform win32 --arch ia32
scripts.predist:mac: node tools/fetch-projector.js --platform darwin && node tools/fetch-flash-browser.js --platform darwin --arch x64 && node tools/preflight.js --platform darwin
scripts.predist:linux: node tools/fetch-projector.js --platform linux && node tools/fetch-flash-browser.js --platform linux --arch x64 && node tools/preflight.js --platform linux
scripts.build:bridge: cmake -S native_bridge -B native_bridge/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native_bridge/build --config Release

author: The Minesa Studios
